column1: # The order of checks of a read GET /v1/get and a listing GET /v1/list (P/01.1 N2.1). The norm refers to this table and does not repeat it in prose.
# The input of the table is one request after the HTTP parsing and the body framing of N2.1 (the request line, the headers, Content-Length and chunked — before the table). Rows in the order of n:
# the first row whose when is true gives the refusal code, kind and the fields fault; none — the request goes on to P/01.2 N3 «check», the table forms/rights-checks.tsv
# (N3 «read» step 2, N3 «list»), and then to its procedure. The table does not read the store state.
# op — * in every row: the request object has no field op, the routes are told by body.path and body.method. Row 1 applies to every request of the doors of the store;
# the other rows — to the paths /v1/get and /v1/list only; another path is not a route of this table (N2, N2.1 «The path»), its order is its own norm.
# Rows 3–5 are the parsing of the query by N2.1, which precedes the procedures of N3; for a read, the key rules before the check is N3 «read» steps 1–2.
# when and fault are CEL (extensions strings, two-var-comprehensions; type(), has(), matches() — standard CEL). Variables:

#var body dyn — the request object {method, path, query, size, role_header}: method — the method of the request line; path — the path of the request target, byte for byte, without the query; query — an object: the name of a parameter → the list of its values in the order of the query, after the parsing of N2.1 «Query» (percent-decoding included), no parameter — no name; size — the number of bytes of the body (for chunked — the decoded bytes), 0 without a body; role_header — not read by this table (its rows are forms/rights-checks.tsv)
#var sock string — the caller role at this check, defined once by P/01.2-R017 (spec/01.2-store.norms.md, N3 check)

#var lone list<string> — the JSON Pointer of every string of the input with a lone surrogate; a query value whose decoded bytes are not UTF-8 carries a lone surrogate U+DC80–U+DCFF (the surrogate escape of the byte) in place of each byte that is not UTF-8, and its pointer is /query/<name>/<index>
#var lim map<string,int> — the parameters of the lesson, only the names of #lim
#lim BODY_LIMIT — P/01.1 N2 POST /v1/write: the body read limit of the door, the effective -max-body of a daemon
#fn key_ok(string) -> bool — the key rules of N1 row.key: not empty, does not start with /, no segment .., at most KEY_BYTES UTF-8 bytes
# fault — the required fields of the refusal; a body refusal MAY also carry size (P/01.1 N2).
# id — the stable address of the row, prefixed rd-, independent of check and the order n; not renamed or renumbered
# check — the refusal name in refusals.tsv; several checks may select the same refusal
